chars.GIRL: GIRL: a small 14-year-old schoolgirl wearing a long white Moroccan school coat (tablier) over a navy tracksuit, with a pink backpack.
chars.MAN: MAN: a tall 38-year-old man wearing a grey office suit with a maroon tie and carrying a black leather briefcase.
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a stocky middle-aged butcher wearing a white butcher apron over a blue checked shirt.
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a stern middle-aged woman wearing a mustard yellow djellaba and a dark green headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Moroccan old-city street in the morning. GIRL walks fast toward school, turning her head back in fear; a few steps behind her MAN follows her closely with a creepy insistent smile. Clear tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In front of a Moroccan middle school gate with green tiles, MAN leans against a wall waiting and staring at GIRL, who hugs her backpack straps and avoids his look, uncomfortable.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan family living room with low sedari sofas, GIRL stands in the doorway hesitating and worried, while FATHER sits on the sofa drinking mint tea, not noticing her.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At the wooden front door of a Moroccan house, MAN arrives smiling holding a big box of sweets and a sugar cone as a marriage-proposal gift, FATHER opens the door surprised and suspicious.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan salon, FATHER stands up angrily refusing with his hand raised in a firm no, while MAN sits on the sofa with the sweets box, annoyed.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan kitchen, MOTHER points her finger and pressures FATHER aggressively, FATHER looks down defeated and sad, holding his head.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan bedroom, GIRL sits on her bed with her school books and backpack beside her, looking at the camera sad and scared, a school timetable on the wall without text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan family court office, a serious judge in a black robe behind a desk raises his hand to firmly refuse, MOTHER and MAN stand in front of the desk shocked and angry. Papers on the desk with no readable text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room at night, MOTHER and MAN shake hands in a secret agreement, smiling slyly, while in the background GIRL hides behind a half-open door, crying in fear.
